summary: Experienced snowshoer fully buried by avalanche in Champion Gulch at Red Mountain Pass; wife dug him out with a snowshoe (~15 min), minor injuries; all four in party walked out and met Ouray County SAR
location: Champion Gulch, CR31 north near Red Mountain Pass
notes: Exact date pinned: article says the pair set out on Sunday and the companion Tuesday fatality at Bollywood (id 1534, 2025-01-07) pins Sunday = 2025-01-05 (weekday-verified). Per CAIC report: man triggered slide ~100 vertical ft on short steep slope where CR31 crosses Champion Gulch; head under snow but kept ski pole above debris; wife crossed one-at-a-time, dug with snowshoe ~15 min; 911 via satellite comms; two passing backcountry users helped; walked out with only minor injuries. No avalanche gear carried, forecast not checked. Same advnture article also covers id 1534.
